kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-files --file-folder-path Business_process/my_first_business_process/MaxCompute/ods_layer --project-id 10000 --keyword ods --project-identifier dw_project --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --use-type NORMAL --file-types 10,23 --owner 37263460000 --node-id 123541234 --need-content false --need-absolute-folder-path false --exact-file-name ods_create.sql --file-id-in 78237,816123 --last-edit-user 38748246285727 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListFiles

parameters.help_en: The path of the folder to which files belong
parameters.help_zh: 文件所在的文件夹路径
parameters.name: file_folder_path

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the workspace ID.

You must configure either the ProjectId or ProjectIdentifier parameter to determine the DataWorks workspace to which the operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。

该参数与ProjectIdentifier参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword in the file names. The keyword is used to perform a fuzzy match. You can specify a keyword to query all files whose names contain the keyword
parameters.help_zh: 文件名称的关键字。支持模糊匹配，即输入关键字即可查询包含该关键字的所有文件
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The name of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the workspace name.

You must configure either the ProjectId or ProjectIdentifier parameter to determine the DataWorks workspace to which the operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的名称。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间名称。

该参数与ProjectId参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_zh: 请求的数据页数，用于翻页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大为100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The module to which the files belong. Valid values:

NORMAL: The files are used for DataStudio.
MANUAL: The files are used for manually triggered nodes.
MANUAL_BIZ: The files are used for manually triggered workflows.
SKIP: The files are used for dry-run nodes in DataStudio.
ADHOCQUERY: The files are used for ad hoc queries.
COMPONENT: The files are used for snippets
parameters.help_zh:
文件所属的功能模块。取值如下：
NORMAL：数据开发。
MANUAL：手动任务。
MANUAL_BIZ：手动业务流程。
SKIP：数据开发的空跑调度。
ADHOCQUERY：临时查询。
COMPONENT：组件管理
parameters.name: use_type

parameters.help_en:
The types of the code in the files.

Valid values: 6 (Shell), 10 (ODPS SQL), 11 (ODPS MR), 23 (Data Integration), 24 (ODPS Script), 97 (PAI), 98 (node group), 99 (zero load), 221 (PyODPS 2), 225 (ODPS Spark), 227 (EMR Hive), 228 (EMR Spark), 229 (EMR Spark SQL), 230 (EMR MR), 239 (OSS object inspection), 257 (EMR Shell), 258 (EMR Spark Shell), 259 (EMR Presto), 260 (EMR Impala), 900 (real-time synchronization), 1002 (PAI inner node), 1089 (cross-tenant collaboration), 1091 (Hologres development), 1093 (Hologres SQL), 1100 (assignment), 1106 (for-each), and 1221 (PyODPS 3)
parameters.help_zh: 文件类型。不同文件类型其代码不同，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/600169.html。，查询文件的代码类型
parameters.name: file_types

parameters.help_en: The ID of the node that is scheduled. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html operation to query the ID of the node
parameters.help_zh: 调度节点的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173979.html接口获取节点ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: Whether the query results contain file content (for files with more content, there may be a long network transmission delay)
parameters.help_zh: 查询结果是否包含文件内容（对于内容较多的文件，可能存在较长的网络传输延时）
parameters.name: need_content

parameters.help_en: Whether the query result contains the path of the folder where the file is located
parameters.help_zh: 查询结果是否包含文件所在的文件夹的路径
parameters.name: need_absolute_folder_path

parameters.help_en: The exact matching file name. The file name of the query result is exactly the same as this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 精确匹配的文件名称，查询结果的文件名称与该参数完全一致
parameters.name: exact_file_name

parameters.help_en: The file ID list. The File ID set of the query result can only be a subset of the list. You can specify up to 50 fileids at a time
parameters.help_zh: Fileld列表，查询结果的文件ID集合只能是该列表的子集。最多支持一次指定50个FileId
parameters.name: file_id_in

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is used to last modify the file
parameters.help_zh: 最近一次编辑文件的用户阿里云用户ID
parameters.name: last_edit_user

AbsoluteFolderPath.description_en: The path of the folder to which the file belongs
AbsoluteFolderPath.description_zh: 文件所在的文件夹的路径

AutoParsing.description_en:
Specifies whether the automatic parsing feature is enabled for the file. Valid values:

true: The automatic parsing feature is enabled for the file.
false: The automatic parsing feature is not enabled for the file.

This parameter is equivalent to the Analyze Code parameter in the Dependencies section of the Properties panel in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
AutoParsing.description_zh:
文件是否开启自动解析功能。取值如下：
true：文件会自动解析代码。
false：文件不会自动解析代码。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>调度依赖”选择“同周期”时的“代码解析”对应

BizId.description_en: The ID of the workflow to which the file belongs. This parameter is deprecated and replaced by the BusinessId parameter
BizId.description_zh: 文件所属的业务流程ID。该字段已废弃，请使用BusinessId字段

BusinessId.description_en: The ID of the workflow to which the file belongs

CommitStatus.description_en: Indicates whether the latest code in the file is committed. Valid values: 0 and 1. The value 0 indicates that the latest code in the file is not committed. The value 1 indicates that the latest code in the file is committed
CommitStatus.description_zh: 文件当前的提交状态，包括0（未提交最新的代码）和1（已提交最新的代码）

ConnectionName.description_en: The ID of the compute engine instance that is used to run the node that corresponds to the file
ConnectionName.description_zh: 文件对应的任务执行时所使用的数据源名称

Content.description_en: This parameter is deprecated. You can call the [GetFile](~~173954#doc-api-dataworks-public-GetFile~~) operation to query the details of the file
Content.description_zh: 该参数已废弃。您可通过[GetFile]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173954.html）接口查询

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the file was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
CreateTime.description_zh: 文件创建时间的毫秒时间戳

CreateUser.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is used to create the file
CreateUser.description_zh: 文件创建者的阿里云用户ID

CurrentVersion.description_en: The latest version number of the file
CurrentVersion.description_zh: 文件当前已经提交的最新版本号

FileFolderId.description_en: The ID of the folder to which the file belongs

FileType.description_en: The type of the code in the file. Valid values: 6 (Shell), 10 (ODPS SQL), 11 (ODPS MR), 23 (Data Integration), 24 (ODPS Script), 99 (zero load), 221 (PyODPS 2), 225 (ODPS Spark), 227 (EMR Hive), 228 (EMR Spark), 229 (EMR Spark SQL), 230 (EMR MR), 239 (OSS object inspection), 257 (EMR Shell), 258 (EMR Spark Shell), 259 (EMR Presto), 260 (EMR Impala), 900 (real-time synchronization), 1089 (cross-tenant collaboration), 1091 (Hologres development), 1093 (Hologres SQL), 1100 (assignment), and 1221 (PyODPS 3)
FileType.description_zh: 文件类型。不同文件类型其代码不同，详情请参见[DataWorks节点合集]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/600169.html）

IsMaxCompute.description_en:
Indicates whether the file needs to be uploaded to MaxCompute if the file is a MaxCompute resource file.

This parameter is returned only if the file is a MaxCompute resource file
IsMaxCompute.description_zh:
如果当前文件是MaxCompute资源文件，该字段标识该资源文件是否需要上传至MaxCompute。

仅当文件是MaxCompute资源文件时才需要配置该参数

LastEditTime.description_en: The time when the file was last modified. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
LastEditTime.description_zh: 最近一次编辑文件的毫秒时间戳

LastEditUser.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is used to last modify the file
LastEditUser.description_zh: 最近一次编辑文件的用户阿里云用户ID

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the auto triggered node that is generated in the scheduling system after the file is committed
NodeId.description_zh: 提交文件后，在调度系统生成的调度任务的ID

Owner.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the file owner
Owner.description_zh: 文件责任人的阿里云用户ID

ParentId.description_en: The ID of the node group file to which the current file belongs. This parameter is returned only if the current file is an inner file of the node group file
ParentId.description_zh: 如果当前文件是组合节点文件的内部文件，该字段标识对应组合节点文件的ID

UseType.description_en:
The module to which the file belongs. Valid values:

NORMAL: The file is used for DataStudio.
MANUAL: The file is used for a manually triggered node.
MANUAL_BIZ: The file is used for a manually triggered workflow.
SKIP: The files is used for a dry-run node in DataStudio.
ADHOCQUERY: The file is used for an ad hoc query.
COMPONENT: The file is used for a snippet
UseType.description_zh:
文件所属的功能模块。取值如下：
NORMAL：数据开发。
MANUAL：手动任务。
MANUAL_BIZ：手动业务流程。
SKIP：数据开发的空跑调度。
ADHOCQUERY：临时查询。
COMPONENT：组件管理

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足条件的数据总条数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can troubleshoot issues based on the ID
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于出现错误后排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
